Hi everyone! 👋 We've all been there: you want to switch from Spotify to YouTube Music (or just sync your playlists), but every tool out there asks for a monthly subscription or limits you to "first 100 songs free". entry.title: Day 20.Create IAM Role for EC2 with Policy Attachment
entry.summary:
Lab Information
When establishing infrastructure on the AWS cloud, Identity and Access Management (IAM) is among the first and most critical services to configure. IAM facilitates the creation and management of user accounts, groups, roles, policies, and other access controls. The Nautilus DevOps team is currently in the process of configuring these resources and has outlined the following requirements: Create an IAM role as below: 1) IAM role name must be iamrole_mark. 2) Entity type must be AWS Service and use case must be EC2. 3) Attach a policy named iampolicy_mark. Log in to AWS Console Use your lab credentials. Open IAM Service In the AWS search bar → type IAM Click IAM Create the IAM Role In the left navigation pane → click Roles Click Create role Select Trusted Entity On the Select trusted entity page: Trusted entity type: AWS service Use case: EC2 Click Next.
Attach Permissions Policy In the permissions list, search for: iampolicy_mark Select the policy iampolicy_mark Click Next
Name the Role On the Name, review, and create page: Role name: iamrole_mark (Optional) Description: IAM role for EC2 with iampolicy_mark attached Click Create role.
